name: Legacy: Motown & More!
blurb: Florida Studio Theatre's Goldstein Cabaret serves up a high-energy revue of Motown, pop and R&B classics spanning the 1960s to today. A lively pick for date night or a family outing in downtown Sarasota's theater district, with tickets starting at $37.

name: Sarasota Farmers Market
address: Lemon Ave & Main St, Sarasota, FL 34236
blurb: A Sarasota Saturday tradition since 1979: fresh produce, flowers, baked goods and live music fill Lemon Avenue and Main Street in the heart of downtown. Free to attend and a favorite for locals and visiting families alike.

name: Sarasota Opera Food & Wine Festival
blurb: A downtown Sarasota food-and-wine celebration with tastings from local eateries and wineries, benefiting the Sarasota Youth Opera program. General admission starts at $75, with a $150 VIP early-entry option.

name: Siesta Key Drum Circle
blurb: A beloved Siesta Key ritual: drummers, dancers and spectators gather on the sand to send off the sunset with rhythm. Free and open to everyone — bring a chair and enjoy one of Sarasota's most iconic outdoor scenes.
